{{Quote|I've received intelligence that the Empire has a secret prison inside the Maelstrom Nebula. It's a dangerous region--impossible to safely navigate.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Oteg]]|<ref name="Maelstrom">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Maelstrom Prison}}</ref>}}
The '''Maelstrom Prison''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] constructed in the heart of [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|the Maelstrom]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] for the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] enemies. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] was imprisoned in the facility in [[3950 BBY]], his life sustained by machinery and [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], until he was [[Battle of the Maelstrom|freed]] by the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] over three hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later.<ref name="Maelstrom" />
